entries.description: Registered session start; read planning + spec; verified prereqs #11b/#12 change-logs present.
Routed analysis to draft ai-assignment.md; mechanically corrected stale Claude model IDs (Opus 4.7/Sonnet 4.6) and rewrote table to match the actual session step structure.

Designed FormReferences module in-conversation (Opus orchestrator matches architecture target; avoids documented Opus/architecture timeout pattern). Algorithm: walk SQL AST, gather FormReference nodes, resolve each segment chain through IAccessObjectModelRegistry starting at Forms/Reports collection. Reason codes for unresolved cases stable per spec.

Landed AccessHarvester.Sql.Parser/FormReferences/: FormReferenceTargetKind, UnresolvedReason, FormReferenceAnnotation (+ Resolved/Unresolved subtypes), FormReferenceCollector (walker), FormReferenceResolver. Added ProjectReference Sql.Parser -> Vba.Resolver to consume IAccessObjectModelRegistry and Synthetic*Declaration types.

dotnet build sequentially: 0 errors, 283 pre-existing warnings. dotnet test --no-build sequentially: Sql.Grammar 72/72, Vba.Parser 54/54, Vba.Grammar 294/294, Vba.Resolver 400/400, Tests 328/330 pass + 2 Windows-only [SkippableFact] skips.
Cross-provider session-verification routed to gpt-5-4. Verdict ISSUES_FOUND with one Major: Bang vs Dot operator semantics ignored.

Accepted verifier finding (option (a) in disagreement procedure). Fix: operator-aware ResolveSegment (Bang on Form/Report -> strict Controls dictionary) and ChooseUnresolvedReason(op-aware) so Dot-at-segment-1 failures emit member-not-found-at-segment-1 rather than control-not-on-form.
Re-verified after fix. Verdict VERIFIED, issues=[].

Registered session start (claude-opus-4-7 @ effort=high). Read planning + spec + Session-1 ai-assignment + verifier output. Confirmed prereqs: Sql.Parser/FormReferences from S1 + Vba.Parser AST + Vba.Resolver IAccessObjectModelRegistry.

Designed DynamicSqlAnalyzer in-conversation (Opus orchestrator matches architecture target; sidesteps documented Opus/architecture timeout pattern per project-guidance convention). Algorithm: forward symbolic-state evaluation. ADT = SqlLiteral|SqlConcat|SqlBranches|SqlFormControlHole|SqlUnknownHole|SqlUnboundVariable. Walk procedure body in source order; If/SelectCase clone Env per branch and merge divergent vars to SqlBranches; recognize OpenRecordset/OpenQueryDef/Execute/RunSQL leaf names as SQL exec sites; flatten symbolic value (cross-product across SqlConcat parts; union across SqlBranches alts) to representative samples capped at MaxFullEnumeration=32 with MaxRepresentativeSamples=5 fallback.

Landed AccessHarvester.Sql.Parser/DynamicSql/: SymbolicSqlValue (ADT), CandidateTemplate, ParameterBinding, UnanalyzableReason, DynamicSqlAnalysisResult (incl. ExecutionSite + Options), DynamicSqlAnalyzer (entry + walker + flatten + render). Operator-aware form-control-chain recognition mirrors FormReferenceResolver Session-1 fix (Bang on Form/Report goes through strict Controls dict).

dotnet build sequentially: 0 errors, 283 pre-existing warnings (NU1903 + CA1416 + xUnit2013, all pre-existing). dotnet test --no-build sequentially: Sql.Grammar 72/72, Vba.Parser 54/54, Vba.Grammar 294/294, Vba.Resolver 400/400, Tests 328/330 pass + 2 Windows-only [SkippableFact] skips. Same totals as Session 1 baseline.

Cross-provider session-verification routed to gpt-5-4. Verdict ISSUES_FOUND with 3 Major findings: (1) string params seeded as unbound-variable instead of unknown hole, (2) combinatorial-blowup cap runs only after full Flatten materializes the cross-product, (3) loop bodies mutate shared env as if executed once.

Accepted all 3 Major findings (option (a) in disagreement procedure). Fixes: (1) made SqlUnknownHole.OriginalExpression nullable + Analyze() seeds env[paramName] = SqlUnknownHole(null, paramName) for each String parameter; (2) added CardinalityCapped(value, cap) precheck + FlattenWithLimit lazy enumerator that bounds intermediate accumulator to <= MaxRepresentativeSamples; (3) added WalkLoopBody helper that snapshots env before walking and post-loop replaces any tracked-variable whose value changed with SqlUnknownHole(null, "<loop-mutation:varName>").

Re-verified after Major fixes. Verdict ISSUES_FOUND with one Minor: record auto-Equals does reference-equality on the IReadOnlyList fields inside SqlConcat/SqlBranches and the AST Expression field inside hole records, so semantically identical SymbolicSqlValues are over-flagged as divergent in WalkLoopBody and AllAlternativesEqual.

Applied Minor fix pre-emptively (Minors do not block commit per workflow Step 7, but the fix is small and improves correctness). Added SymbolicSqlValueEquality.DeepEquals — structural recursion across Parts/Alternatives, semantic-field comparison on hole records (OriginalText, UnresolvedReason, ResolvedTarget by reference), case-insensitive Name comparison on SqlUnboundVariable. Routed to from WalkLoopBody and AllAlternativesEqual; skipped round-3 reverification since the Minor was non-blocking and the fix is purely a structural-equality refinement.
